about_the_game:
Embark on a sonic journey through the heart of Learning Factory with this captivating soundtrack.

A harmonious fusion of gentle, soothing melodies and dynamic, pulsating rhythms, this album perfectly encapsulates the serene process of automation and the thrill of innovation. Each track is designed to enhance your gaming experience, weaving an audio tapestry that deepens your emotional connection to the game.

Composed by Vladislav Isaev and Elena Isaeva (Broadcast of Variants) at Monokanal.

The tracks are presented in two formats: WAV Uncompressed 44100 Hz 16bit + MP3 44100 Hz 320kb/s.

As a bonus, this pack also contains a 7 tracks from Early Access version in MP3 44100 Hz 320kb/s.

To play the Soundtrack, find it on Learning Factory's page in your Steam Library.
